name: LinkedIn Toolkit
author: momo
tagline: Fill and submit LinkedIn Easy Apply forms automatically, within limits you set.
description: LinkedIn Toolkit fills Easy Apply forms from the profile you save once and submits applications that match your rules. You choose the job titles, the locations, the companies to skip, and how many applications go out per day. Every submission is logged with time, company and result, so you always know exactly what was sent.

name: War3 Hotkey Editor
author: momo
tagline: Design a custom Warcraft III hotkey layout on a visual grid, then export it.
description: See every Warcraft III command on one grid: click a cell and press a key to bind it. The editor warns you when two commands collide, saves your layout as you work, and exports the exact config file the game reads. No more editing text files by hand.

name: War3 Map Hacker
author: momo
tagline: Reveal the whole battlefield in Warcraft III, including fogged ground and enemy builds.
description: War3 Map Hacker gives you full vision of the map: the complete minimap, unit positions, and the buildings opponents are raising, even through fog of war. Replays can be replayed with the same full view so you can study your own games. Intended for offline play, replays and practice — respect the rules of whatever ladder or server you play on.

name: RA2 Map Hacker
author: momo
tagline: Reveal the whole map in Red Alert 2 and Yuri's Revenge.
description: RA2 Map Hacker lifts the shroud in Red Alert 2 and Yuri's Revenge: see every unit, building and hidden corner of the map while you play. Built for skirmish, offline games and replays — respect the rules of whatever lobby you join.

name: Canada28
author: boomcat
tagline: A calculator for the Canada 28 draw: sums, patterns and history in one place.
description: Canada28 is a calculator for Canada 28. Enter a draw result and it works out the sum, big or small, odd or even, wave and dragon values, then keeps the history locally so you can check any past period. It calculates your numbers — it does not predict future draws.
